# Psalm 119 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

### ALEPH

**1** How happy are those whose lives are without blame — who live by the LORD's instructions!

**2** How happy are those who obey his decrees and search for him with all their heart!

**3** They don't do what's wrong; they follow his path.

**4** You have given us your guidelines and told us to follow them carefully.

**5** I wish my life was more consistent in keeping your rules!

**6** Then I wouldn't be embarrassed when I measured my life against your commands.

**7** I will praise you with an honest heart as I learn your just regulations.

**8** I will obey your rules — please don't give up on me!

### BETH

**9** How can a young person stay pure? By living according to your word.

**10** I've searched for you with everything I have — don't let me drift from your commands!

**11** I've hidden your word deep in my heart so that I won't sin against you.

**12** You are worthy of praise, LORD! Teach me your rules.

**13** I recite out loud all the regulations you've given.

**14** I find as much joy in following your instructions as I would in finding a fortune.

**15** I will think deeply about your guidelines and pay attention to your ways.

**16** I take great pleasure in your rules — I will not forget your word.

### GIMEL

**17** Be good to your servant so I can live and obey your word.

**18** Open my eyes so I can see the amazing things hidden in your instructions.

**19** I'm just passing through this earth — don't hide your commands from me!

**20** My soul aches with longing for your regulations — every moment of every day.

**21** You reprimand the arrogant — those who are cursed because they ignore your commands.

**22** Take the shame and contempt away from me, because I've obeyed your decrees.

**23** Even when powerful people sit around bad-mouthing me, your servant keeps reflecting on your rules.

**24** Your decrees are my greatest pleasure — they're my best advisors.

### DALETH

**25** I'm lying face down in the dust — revive me as you promised!

**26** I told you about my life and you answered; now teach me your rules.

**27** Help me understand what your guidelines mean, and I'll reflect on your miracles.

**28** My soul is weeping with grief — strengthen me as you promised.

**29** Keep me from dishonest ways; graciously give me your instructions.

**30** I've chosen the path of faithfulness; I've committed to your regulations.

**31** I hold tight to your decrees, LORD — don't let me be disgraced!

**32** I will run to follow your commands because you have set my heart free!

### HE

**33** Teach me, LORD, how to follow your rules, and I'll keep them to the very end.

**34** Give me understanding so I can obey your instructions — I'll follow them wholeheartedly.

**35** Guide me along the path of your commands, because that's where I find happiness.

**36** Turn my heart toward your decrees and away from selfish greed.

**37** Keep my eyes from looking at worthless things; give me life through your ways.

**38** Confirm your promise to your servant — the promise that leads to honoring you.

**39** Take away the disgrace I'm dreading, because your regulations are good.

**40** Look — I long for your guidelines! Give me life through your righteousness.

### VAV

**41** Let your faithful love come to me, LORD — your salvation, just as you promised.

**42** Then I'll have an answer for anyone who mocks me, because I trust your word.

**43** Don't take the truth away from me completely, because I'm counting on your regulations.

**44** I will always obey your instructions — forever and ever.

**45** I will live in freedom because I've committed to following your guidelines.

**46** I will talk about your decrees in front of kings without being embarrassed.

**47** I take real pleasure in your commands — I truly love them.

**48** I reach out toward your commands, which I love, and I reflect deeply on your rules.

### ZAYIN

**49** Remember the promise you made to your servant — the one that gave me hope.

**50** When I'm suffering, this is what comforts me: your promise gives me life.

**51** Arrogant people mock me relentlessly, but I don't turn away from your instructions.

**52** I remember your regulations from long ago, LORD, and they comfort me.

**53** Rage grips me when I see wicked people abandoning your instructions.

**54** Your rules have become the soundtrack of my life wherever I've lived.

**55** At night I remember your name, LORD, and I keep your instructions.

**56** This has been my experience: I've kept your guidelines.

### CHETH

**57** The LORD is all I need! I've promised to obey your words.

**58** I've begged for your favor with all my heart — be kind to me as you promised.

**59** I've examined my life and turned my steps back toward your decrees.

**60** I hurry without hesitation to obey your commands.

**61** The wicked have tied me up with their ropes, but I haven't forgotten your instructions.

**62** I get up at midnight to thank you for your just regulations.

**63** I'm a friend to everyone who honors you — to everyone who follows your guidelines.

**64** LORD, the earth is full of your faithful love — teach me your rules!

### TETH

**65** You've been so good to your servant, LORD — just like you said you would.

**66** Teach me good judgment and knowledge, because I believe in your commands.

**67** Before I suffered, I used to wander off — but now I cling to your word.

**68** You are good, and what you do is good. Teach me your rules.

**69** Arrogant people smear me with lies, but I obey your guidelines with all my heart.

**70** Their hearts are cold and hard, but I find my joy in your instructions.

**71** My suffering was actually good for me — it taught me to pay attention to your rules.

**72** Your instructions are worth more to me than millions in gold and silver.

### YODH

**73** You made me and shaped me with your own hands — give me wisdom to learn your commands.

**74** Those who honor you will see me and be encouraged, because I've put my hope in your word.

**75** I know, LORD, that your regulations are fair — you were right to make me suffer.

**76** Let your faithful love be my comfort, just as you promised your servant.

**77** Surround me with your tender mercies so I can live, because your instructions are my greatest pleasure.

**78** Put the arrogant to shame — they wronged me with lies. But I will keep reflecting on your guidelines.

**79** Let those who honor you rally around me — those who know your decrees.

**80** May my heart be completely devoted to your rules, so I'll never be ashamed.

### KAPH

**81** I'm desperate for your rescue; I'm holding onto your word.

**82** My eyes are straining to see your promise fulfilled — 'When will you comfort me?'

**83** I've become like a dried-out wineskin hanging in smoke, but I haven't forgotten your rules.

**84** How much longer must your servant wait? When will you bring my persecutors to justice?

**85** The arrogant have dug traps for me — they don't live by your instructions.

**86** All your commands are trustworthy. People are persecuting me unfairly — help me!

**87** They've nearly wiped me off the earth, but I haven't abandoned your guidelines.

**88** Preserve my life with your faithful love so I can obey the decrees you've spoken.

### LAMEDH

**89** LORD, your word stands firm forever — it is established in heaven.

**90** Your faithfulness continues through every generation — you established the earth and it endures.

**91** Everything continues to this day according to your design, because all things serve you.

**92** If your instructions hadn't been my joy, I would have died in my misery.

**93** I will never forget your guidelines — they're the reason I'm still alive!

**94** I belong to you — rescue me! I've devoted myself to your guidelines.

**95** Wicked people are waiting to destroy me, but I will carefully consider your decrees.

**96** I've seen that everything has its limits, but your commands have no boundaries at all.

### MEM

**97** I love your instructions so much! I think about them all day long.

**98** Your commands make me wiser than my enemies because they're always with me.

**99** I have more insight than all my teachers because your decrees are what I think about.

**100** I have more understanding than older people because I follow your guidelines.

**101** I've kept my feet away from every evil path so I can obey your word.

**102** I haven't turned away from your regulations because you yourself have taught me.

**103** Your words taste so sweet to me — sweeter than honey in my mouth!

**104** Your guidelines give me understanding — that's why I hate every dishonest path.

### NUN

**105** Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my path.

**106** I've made a solemn promise — and I meant it — to follow your just regulations.

**107** I'm suffering terribly, LORD — give me life again, just as you promised!

**108** LORD, accept the praise I offer you freely, and teach me your regulations.

**109** My life is constantly in danger, but I never forget your instructions.

**110** The wicked have set a trap for me, but I haven't strayed from your guidelines.

**111** Your decrees are my permanent possession — they are the joy of my heart!

**112** I am determined to obey your rules to the very end.

### SAMEKH

**113** I can't stand people who are two-faced, but I love your instructions.

**114** You are my safe place and my shield — I put my hope in your word.

**115** Get away from me, you people who do evil! I intend to obey my God's commands.

**116** Support me as you promised so I can live! Don't let my hope be crushed.

**117** Hold me up so I'll be safe, and I'll always pay attention to your rules.

**118** You reject everyone who strays from your rules — their deception gets them nowhere.

**119** You throw away all the wicked people on earth like worthless slag — so I love your decrees.

**120** I tremble in awe of you; I stand in reverent fear of your judgments.

### AYIN

**121** I've done what is fair and right — don't leave me at the mercy of my oppressors.

**122** Guarantee your servant's well-being; don't let the arrogant crush me.

**123** My eyes are straining to see your salvation and the righteousness you promised.

**124** Treat your servant with faithful love, and teach me your rules.

**125** I'm your servant — give me discernment so I can understand your decrees.

**126** It's time for the LORD to act — people are breaking your instructions!

**127** That's why I love your commands more than gold — even the purest gold.

**128** That's why I follow all your guidelines carefully. I hate every dishonest path.

### PE

**129** Your decrees are incredible — that's why I obey them wholeheartedly.

**130** When your words are explained, they bring light — they give understanding to ordinary people.

**131** I open my mouth wide, panting with desire, because I long for your commands.

**132** Look at me and show me grace, as you always do for those who love your name.

**133** Direct my steps according to your word — don't let any sin control me.

**134** Free me from human oppression so I can obey your guidelines.

**135** Let your face shine on your servant, and teach me your rules.

**136** Rivers of tears pour from my eyes because people don't follow your instructions.

### TSADHE

**137** You are righteous, LORD, and your regulations are fair.

**138** The decrees you've established are righteous and completely trustworthy.

**139** My passion is eating me alive because my enemies have forgotten your words.

**140** Your promises have been tested and proven, and your servant loves them.

**141** I may be unimportant and looked down on, but I haven't forgotten your guidelines.

**142** Your righteousness is eternal, and your instructions are true.

**143** Trouble and anguish have found me, but your commands are still my delight.

**144** Your decrees are righteous forever — give me understanding so I can truly live.

### QOPH

**145** I cry out with all my heart — answer me, LORD! I will obey your rules.

**146** I cry out to you — rescue me so I can follow your decrees!

**147** I get up before the sun rises and cry for help — I'm counting on your words.

**148** I stay awake through the night watches to reflect on your promise.

**149** Listen to me because of your faithful love; LORD, give me life through your justice.

**150** My cruel persecutors are closing in — they're completely out of touch with your instructions.

**151** But you are close, LORD, and every one of your commands is true.

**152** I learned long ago from your decrees that you established them to last forever.

### RESH

**153** Look at my suffering and rescue me, because I haven't forgotten your instructions.

**154** Fight for me and set me free; give me life as you promised.

**155** Salvation is miles away from the wicked — they don't even bother looking for your rules.

**156** Your mercy is so great, LORD — give me life through your regulations.

**157** I have many enemies and persecutors, but I haven't veered from your decrees.

**158** I look at those who betray you and feel sick, because they don't keep your word.

**159** See how much I love your guidelines! Preserve my life through your faithful love.

**160** The core of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous regulations lasts forever.

### SHIN

**161** Powerful people persecute me for no reason, but my heart trembles only at your words.

**162** I celebrate your word like someone who discovers an enormous treasure.

**163** I hate and despise lies, but I love your instructions.

**164** I praise you seven times a day for your righteous regulations.

**165** People who love your instructions have deep peace — nothing makes them stumble.

**166** I wait for your salvation, LORD, and I carry out your commands.

**167** I obey your decrees — I love them so much!

**168** I follow your guidelines and your decrees, because my whole life is an open book before you.

### TAV

**169** Let my cry reach you, LORD! Give me understanding, as your word promises.

**170** Let my prayer come before you; rescue me as you promised.

**171** Let praise flow from my lips, because you teach me your rules.

**172** Let my tongue sing about your word, because all your commands are right.

**173** Reach out your hand to help me, because I've chosen your guidelines.

**174** I long for your salvation, LORD — your instructions are my delight.

**175** Let me live so I can praise you, and let your regulations support me.

**176** I've wandered away like a lost sheep — come find your servant, because I haven't forgotten your commands.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **119:9-11**: These three verses are the psalm's most quotable section: How do you stay pure? Guard your life with God's word. Seek God wholeheartedly. Hide his word in your heart. Simple, practical, revolutionary.

- **119:71**: 'My suffering was actually good for me.' That's a statement that can only be made in hindsight. In the moment, suffering feels pointless. Looking back, the psalmist sees it was the classroom where obedience was learned.

- **119:105**: The most famous verse in the psalm, and possibly the most famous metaphor in the Bible: God's word is a lamp. Not a searchlight — a lamp. It shows you the next step, not the whole road. Faith means walking with limited visibility.

- **119:176**: After 176 verses about loving God's word, the psalm ends with: 'I've wandered like a lost sheep.' Even the most devoted believer still needs to be found. The psalm doesn't end with human achievement but with divine grace.

— PNEUMA
